notes.title: Casina Turns 4 – Thank You for 4 Years of Chaos, Comedy, and Love!
notes.content:
Four years ago, we released [i]Casina: The Forgotten Comedy[/i], a strange little visual novel born from our love of mythology, classic theater, and humor. We never expected it to resonate with so many of you and yet here we are, four years later, still getting messages from players who laughed, cringed and somehow saw themselves in this chaotic cast of characters.

From the bottom of our hearts: [b]thank you.[/b]
Your support, reviews, memes, and incredibly detailed feedback over the years have meant the world to us. You kept Casina alive, and we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes to give something back.

[h3]What’s Next for Casina?[/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce some major updates coming your way:

[list]
[*] [b]A Fully Remastered Version[/b] – Visuals, UI, and overall experience will be refreshed for modern standards while keeping the soul intact.
[*] [b]Localization Incoming[/b] – Casina will finally be available in more languages, so new players around the world can join in the fun.
[*] [b]Free for Current Owners[/b] – The remaster will be 100% free for everyone who already owns the game. No paid upgrade, no nonsense.
[/list]

We’ll share more details soon, including sneak peeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/aeb4563e53b64e00856a687e3e993113c771ec02.jpg[/img]

Thank you again for being part of Casina’s journey. Whether you’ve been here since day one or just stumbled upon it recently, we’re grateful to have you in our little theatrical disaster of a family.

Here’s to four years of laughs...and what’s still to come.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames/]Feel free to follow us here on Steam for news, announcements and giveaways![/url]
[i]The show must go on![/i]

<3 Neoclassic Games

notes.title: Casina - Update v1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are back with another announcement, this time introducing our [h3]Patch 1.1[/h3].
Since Casina's launch we have been [b]closely reading all your reviews and feedback[/b]! We put everything together in a big list and here we are with a new fresh update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/cbb5c0997dfd33af04e7b98c5e2d5c1b3ff23115.jpg[/img]
[h3]
Patch Notes:[/h3]
[i]- [b]Fixed the non-working windowed option[/b]
- Now the game fully supports multiple screen resolutions! You will be able to adjust your game window as you like!
- Choices now display a black text color (more readable)
- Fixed missing Alcesimus name in the textbox
- [b]Fixed all the save/loading problems after Act 3[/b] (you need to delete your old saves by clicking on the "Reset Progress button" in options.
- Added missing lore entry for the Italian version of the game
- Fixed UI related bugs for the Chinese version of the game
- Many improvements to the German version of the game
- Improvements to our animation system and character expressions
- The game is more stable when alt-tabbing[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/aeb4563e53b64e00856a687e3e993113c771ec02.jpg[/img]

We are still working on a few other improvements but we really wanted to publish this update as soon as possible.
Thanks for the awesome support and keep sending us feedback via private message or review!

notes.title: Demo 2.0 and preparing for Full Release!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We are incredibly close to Release! Actually the full game will be available in just 3 days!

I must admit we worked really hard on this game, we learned how to fully animate and fully voice a Visual Novel, it was quite challenging but we finally reached the finish line!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/878f1ec3e03a748cdd4d8a2c0df7c14fbe7715fc.jpg[/img]

[b]During the last few months we spent our time improving a lot of stuff, many of which are also available in our Demo:[/b]
[i]- Many improvements to our Visual Novel engine
- Improved animated character models, (characters feature more expressions, emotes and stances)
- Improved artworks transition flow
- Added custom screen shake effect
- Added the encyclopedia
- Codex can be automatically showed in-game or disabled
- Added a cute "codex unlocked" icon
- Added many Sfx to the game 
- Added a new game trailer
- Fully localized the game in Portuguese - Brazilian Portuguese
- Fully localized the game in Turkish
- Many bug fixes and more.[/i]


Lastly we really want to personally thank everyone who supported, helped and worked with us during development.

[b]You are awesome![/b]

Also if you can, help us spread the word about our game. Tell your friends, send an email to your favorite reviewer or do nothing! Everything is appreciated ^^
[b]See you in a couple of days with the Game Release![/b]

notes.title: Demo vers 1.2!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Several weeks have passed since we released our Demo! 
We used the time to make lots of improvements and add new features that will be available in our final game.
Some of this new good stuff is related to our demo as well. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/cbb5c0997dfd33af04e7b98c5e2d5c1b3ff23115.jpg[/img]

[i]Here are the patch notes.[/i]

[i]- Several improvements to our animations. Character will show different body poses and facial expressions in a more natural way.
- Animated backgrounds are finally in the game!
- Animated main menu finally released
- Added a new song
- The game is available to be played in Polish as well![/i]


We will keep you updated with our progress so far. Yeah we delayed release date a bit because we really want to have our game in the best shape!

[b]What's next:[/b]
[i]- Full Portuguese and Brazilian Portuguese localization
- Add a Screen shake effect
- Add several sound effects
[/i]
[b]Also if you want to contribute to the project:[/b]
[i]- Helping us localizing the game in a new language
- Helping us spreading the word about the game and/or doing some community work
- Becoming a beta tester
[/i]
let us know with a comment below or send us an email: info.neoclassicgame@gmail.com
Until our next update!

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are super happy that our demo has got so many downloads in a such short period of time. You guys are amazing. Since its release, we have been busy working on some fixes since we had to publish it in a rush in order to join the Steam Game Festival.

[b]We appreciated all the positive feedback so far though![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/cbb5c0997dfd33af04e7b98c5e2d5c1b3ff23115.jpg[/img]

[b]This is a juicy update, here are the patch notes:[/b]
[i]- Added full support for the Spanish language
- Added full support for the Chinese language
- Fixed the main menu font size problems and in-game menu
- Fixed the font related problems for the German, Chinese and Spanish version of the Demo.
- Improved the options section of the game (Brightness, Hue, Saturation of the textbox)
- Some improvements to the character animations
- Added support for Animated Backgrounds (they couldn't make it but they will be here with our next update)[/i]


[b]Feel free to contact us if you have suggestions or ideas! Simply open a forum post in the community section of our game.[/b]
Until next time!
